title: 第25章 城主有请第26章 挣钱的希娅
slug: 你好是寄往魔神堡垒的信吗
lines: 【叮！周常委托已经完成】
【完成内容：成功送达512封回信至新约城指定委托人手中。】
【奖励派发中……】
【您已成功送达469封信件，获得随机初级魔法x469。】
【重复魔法将自动转化为对应熟练度。】
【恭喜宿主获得：】
【金系初级魔法——坚硬58→坚硬lv6】
【木系初级魔法——促生术55→促生术lv6】
【水系初级魔法——造水术49→造水术lv5】
【火系初级魔法——点火术52→点火术lv6】
【土系初级魔法——岩甲术30→岩甲术lv5】
【电系初级魔法——电火花30→电火花lv5】
【风系初级魔法——漂浮术25→漂浮术lv7】
【冰系初级魔法——冷冻术24→冷冻术lv5】
【黑暗系初级魔法——疾走23→疾走lv5】
【光系初级魔法——照明术47→照明术lv5】
【灵魂系初级魔法——清醒术5→清醒术lv2】
【新增魔法：】
【风系初级魔法——引风术25→引风术lv4】（效果：制造一阵微弱气流，可用于吹散灰尘或微弱改变细小物体轨迹）
【土系初级魔法——松土术15→生土术lv2】（效果：略微活化一小片土壤，使其更适合种植普通植物，效果微弱）
【水系初级魔法——清洁术*10→清洁术lv2】（效果：清除小范围内物体表面的轻微污渍和灰尘）
【额外奖励：魔力储备+150】
【宿主：林鬼】
【阶位：高阶下位法师】
【魔力储备：（14001514）距离下一阶段突破差486点魔力】
【叮！周常委托开始生成。】
【开始检索宿主收取的信件数量。】
【检索时间剩余.......6天23h】
------「愿每一份思念都能穿越黑暗，抵达彼岸」
又是一股庞杂的基础魔法知识涌入脑海，林鬼对此早已习惯，内心毫无波澜。
这些初级魔法对他如今的实力提升确实有限。
他好奇地再次施展【电火花术】，想看看熟练度提升到lv7后实际效果如何。
吟唱声几乎缩短到了3秒。
content_en:
【bite! Weekly commission has been completed]
[Complete content: 512 replies were successfully delivered to the designated client in New Testament City. 】
[Rewards are being distributed...]
[You have successfully delivered 469 letters and received random primary magic x469. 】
[Repeated magic will be automatically converted into corresponding proficiency. 】
[Congratulations to the host for getting:]
[Primary magic of the metal system—Hardness 58→Hardness lv6]
[Elementary magic of the wood system - growth promotion 55 → growth promotion lv6]
[Elementary Water Magic——Water Making 49 → Water Making lv5]
[Primary Fire Magic——Ignition 52 → Ignition lv6]
[Earth primary magic - Rock Armor 30 → Rock Armor lv5]
[Electric primary magic——Electric spark 30→Electric spark lv5]
[Wind primary magic——Levitation 25→Levitation lv7]
[Elementary magic of the ice system - Freezing 24 → Freezing lv5]
[Dark primary magic—Sprint 23→Sprint lv5]
[Primary magic of light system——Illumination 47→Illumination lv5]
[Soul-based primary magic - Awakening 5 → Awakening lv2]
[New magic:]
[Elementary magic of the wind system - Wind Drawing 25 → Wind Drawing lv4] (Effect: Create a weak air current, which can be used to blow away dust or slightly change the trajectory of small objects)
[Elementary magic of the earth system - Soil loosening 15 → Soil-generating lv 2] (Effect: Slightly activate a small patch of soil, making it more suitable for growing ordinary plants, the effect is weak)
[Primary Water Magic——Cleaning Technique*10→Cleaning Technique lv2] (Effect: Remove slight stains and dust on the surface of objects within a small area)
[Additional reward: Magic power reserve +150]
[Host: Lin Gui]
[Rank: High-level low-level mage]
[Magic reserve: (14001514) 486 magic points short of the next stage of breakthrough]
[Ding! Weekly commissions start to be generated. 】
[Start retrieving the number of letters received by the host. 】
[The remaining search time...6 days and 23 hours]
------"May every thought pass through the darkness and reach the other side."
Another huge amount of basic magic knowledge poured into his mind. Lin Gui had long been accustomed to this and felt no disturbance in his heart.
These elementary magics are indeed limited in improving his current strength.
He curiously cast [Electric Spark Technique] again, wanting to see the actual effect after his proficiency was raised to level 7.
The chant was shortened to almost 3 seconds.
